changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6a item 3: the completion notice the Dispatcher's own agent receives after one of its Team's leaders settles a team.create-with-prompt turn (R16, deliverCompletionToDispatcher) always read 'TeamMate <name> has finished its task,' misdescribing a Team leader as a TeamMate. Added role: TeammateRole to TeammateCompletionFact (service/completion-router/index.ts) and threaded the producing AgentService's own role (fixed for its lifetime, passed once into EntityTurnCoordinatorOptions at construction) through service/agent/turn.ts's fact construction. service/agent/completion-renderer.ts's teammateStatusLine now words the sentence by the producer's actual role: a Team leader completion reads 'Team leader <name> has finished its task.' (and failed/stopped variants); an ordinary TeamMate completion, the only other role a delivered completion is produced by today, is unchanged. The Dispatcher-role branch is exhaustive but currently unreached -- the Dispatcher's own agent never attaches a completion-delivery closure to its own turns today, so 'The Dispatcher agent has finished its task.' is not yet observable, but is now correctly worded for when it is. workflowStatusLine is untouched. No persisted format, public API, or MCP/Command contract changed.
